rows.label: Troy
rows.description: ancient Homeric-era city in northwest Asia Minor; it is known as the setting for the Greek myth of the Trojan war
rows.hook: was the ancient city besieged for ten years in Homer's legend, ending with a giant wooden horse

rows.label: Babylon
rows.description: capital city of Babylonia and an archaeological site in modern-day Iraq
rows.hook: was a mighty ancient Mesopotamian capital, legendary for its hanging gardens and tower

rows.label: Machu Picchu
rows.description: 15th-century Inca citadel in the Peruvian Andes and UNESCO World Heritage Site
rows.hook: is the mountaintop citadel nicknamed the Lost City of the Incas

rows.label: Pompeii
rows.description: ancient Roman city near modern Naples, Italy
rows.hook: was frozen in time when Mount Vesuvius buried it in volcanic ash

rows.label: Roanoke Colony
rows.description: former colony in present-day Dare County, North Carolina, US (1585–1590)
rows.hook: is where English settlers vanished, leaving behind a mysterious carved message

rows.label: Petra
rows.description: ancient rock-cut historical city in Jordan
rows.hook: is the rose-red city carved into sandstone cliffs, with a famous rock-cut treasury

rows.label: Carthage
rows.description: historical city in Tunisia
rows.hook: was the North African power that fought Rome in the Punic Wars

rows.label: Tenochtitlan
rows.description: former city-state in the Valley of Mexico
rows.hook: was the island capital of the Aztecs, built in the middle of a lake

rows.label: Chichen Itza
rows.description: pre-Columbian Maya city in Mexico
rows.hook: is a Maya city whose stepped pyramid El Castillo draws crowds at the equinox

rows.label: Ephesus
rows.description: ancient Greek city in Anatolia
rows.hook: was a Greek-founded city near the Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World

rows.label: Teotihuacan
rows.description: ancient Mesoamerican city
rows.hook: is the ancient city of the Pyramids of the Sun and the Moon

rows.label: Mycenae
rows.description: ancient city, now an archaeological site in Argolis, Greece
rows.hook: was a Bronze Age stronghold tied to the legendary King Agamemnon

rows.label: Ur
rows.description: ancient Mesopotamian city-state

rows.label: Nineveh
rows.description: ancient Assyrian city, capital of the Neo-Assyrian Empire

rows.label: Cahokia
rows.description: archaeological site near East St. Louis, Illinois, USA

rows.label: Pripyat
rows.description: abandoned city in Kyiv Oblast, Ukraine
rows.hook: was evacuated and left empty after the nearby Chernobyl reactor exploded

rows.label: Persepolis
rows.description: ancient city in Marvdasht County, Iranian national heritage site and World heritage site
rows.hook: was the ceremonial capital of the ancient Persian Achaemenid Empire

rows.label: Mohenjo-daro
rows.description: archaeological site in the province of Sindh, Pakistan

rows.label: Knossos
rows.description: ancient Minoan through Roman administrative center and city
rows.hook: was the grand palace complex of the Minoans, linked to the legend of the Minotaur

rows.label: Herculaneum
rows.description: Roman town destroyed by eruption of Mount Vesuvius
rows.hook: was buried by Vesuvius alongside its better-known neighbour, which was dug up first

rows.label: Pergamon
rows.description: ancient city of Ionia in modern-day Turkey and UNESCO World Heritage Site

rows.label: Çatalhöyük
rows.description: archaeological site in Konya Province, Turkey
rows.hook: was an enormous Stone Age settlement, among the earliest known proto-cities

rows.label: Great Zimbabwe
rows.description: ruined city in the south-eastern hills of Zimbabwe near Lake Mutirikwe and the town of Masvingo, was once the capital of the Kingdom of Zimbabwe during the country's Late Iron Age

rows.label: Sigiriya
rows.description: ancient rock fortress near Dambulla, Sri Lanka.

rows.label: Ctesiphon
rows.description: capital of the Iranian empire in the Parthian and Sasanian eras in present Iraq

rows.label: Port Royal
rows.description: settlement in Jamaica

rows.label: Palmyra
rows.description: ancient city in Homs Governorate, Syria
rows.hook: was a wealthy caravan city on the Silk Road, famed for its colonnaded ruins

rows.label: Tikal
rows.description: ruins of major ancient Maya city
rows.hook: is a Maya city of towering temple-pyramids rising above the rainforest canopy

rows.label: Skara Brae
rows.description: Neolithic archaeological site in Scotland

rows.label: Harappa
rows.description: archaeological site in Punjab, Pakistan

rows.label: Hattusa
rows.description: capital of Hittite empire
